module: Discovery of a level's spawn points in career. Every second, if the player is driving an inventory vehicle, it tests the distance to undiscovered points (threshold 75 m); on discovery it adds a logbook entry (career_modules_logbook.spawnPointUnlocked), emits the onSpawnPointUnlocked(spawnPoint) hook and clears gameplay_rawPois. The state is saved in <save>/career/spawnPoints.json.
notes: Data: table level -> spawn point object name -> true.
The file is ignored (empty table) if the info.json version is < 42.
No check is made during the tutorial.
getSpawnPointTranslation is defined but never used.

getUnlockedSpawnpointsData.desc: Returns the table of discovered points, per level.

isSpawnPointDiscovered.desc: Indicates whether a spawn point is discovered (creates the level entry if needed).

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: every second (accumulated dtReal), looks for an undiscovered point within 75 m of the player vehicle and unlocks it.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: loads the discovered points if the career is already active (returns false otherwise).

onCareerActive.desc: Hook: loads the discovered points when the career becomes active.
